Mochi.look: a small scruffy ginger street cat with a torn left ear, huge green eyes, thin, dusty orange fur, no collar
Mochi.personality: The underdog hero. Poor, proud, kind to those weaker than her. Never begs. Quietly brilliant at cooking fish.
Mochi.voice_style: young, proud, hurt but holding it together

Duchess.look: a fluffy pure-white Persian cat with blue eyes, a pearl necklace, a tiny gold tiara, nose always in the air
Duchess.personality: The rich villain. Owns the market street. Cruel for fun, terrified of losing status.

Rocco.look: a big muscular grey bulldog in a black leather jacket and gold chain, permanent scowl
Rocco.personality: Duchess's bodyguard boyfriend. All muscle, laughs at his own jokes, secretly a softie.

Bruno.look: a big clumsy golden retriever street dog with floppy ears, a faded red bandana, goofy loyal smile
Bruno.personality: Mochi's best friend. Not clever, endlessly loyal, the comic relief. Always has her back.

Granny.look: a kind elderly woman with round glasses, silver hair in a bun, a purple knitted cardigan, an apron dusted with flour
Granny.personality: Runs a tiny failing bakery. Feeds every stray. Sees Mochi's talent before anyone else.
